title: Letter 46 — The Day of Judgment Draws Near
attribution_note: Letter 46 of 46 in the collection Letters Sent — see Letter 1 for provenance.

sections.heading: The day of the Lord cometh as a thief in the night

pairs.en: Christians! The judgment of Christ draws near and is already close at hand; and as *“a thief in the night,”* that day will come unlooked for [2 Peter 3:10], and in whatever state it finds each man, with that he shall appear at that Dread Judgment. It will find one in fornication, and with that he shall appear; another in murder, and with that he shall appear; another in drunkenness, and with that he shall appear; another in evil-speaking, another in slander, another in lying, cunning and hypocrisy; another in injury and offence against his neighbour — and with that each shall appear. Some it will find at banquets and feasts, some at cards, some at operas and masquerades — and so they shall appear there. Some in quarrel and strife — and so they shall appear there. Some in bribery and ruinous taking of gifts — and with that they shall appear there. Some in dancing, in dances, games and other disorders — and with that they shall appear there. Others in other lawlessness — and with that they shall appear there.

sections.heading: Joy for the godly, and woe for the lawless

pairs.en: Pious and God-fearing soul! Rejoice, for eternal salvation draws near to thee. Thou shalt stand on the right hand of the Judge, the King of Heaven, and shalt hear that most longed-for voice: *“Come, ye blessed of My Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world”* [Matthew 25:34]. Woe to those named above and to other lawless Christians! They shall be punished by the righteous judgment of God; they shall be sent into the eternal fire, and with the devil and his angels shall be tormented unto ages of ages — more than those who know not God, the Turks and the idolaters.

Therefore I beseech you, beloved, I beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ: spare your souls and repent, that ye perish not for ever. God still waits for us; He still is longsuffering. Blessed shall he be who truly turns and repents; wretched shall he be who remains in hardness of heart. He will repent, weep and wail in that hour, but already it is too late and of no avail, for with weeping he shall also depart into eternal torment.

I write this to you from Christian love and pity. Receive a short but profitable exhortation. Look not upon those who are already openly godless, and who neglect the law of the Lord, for they are not instructed in it.

sections.heading: Hearken to Christ, and prepare for His coming

pairs.en: Therefore hearken unto me, who desire your salvation as I desire my own; and more than this, hearken unto Christ Himself, who hungers and thirsts for our salvation, who for this very cause came into the world, suffered and died, that He might see us saved. Fulfil, then, beloved, the holy and saving will of Christ, and lose not the eternal salvation that was valued at the price of the Blood and death of Christ. The angels of God in the heavens and the holy souls shall rejoice over us, when we turn and repent.

Christ the Lord will receive us with joy and will forgive us all our sins. Therefore let us repent, and be always in readiness to meet Christ the Lord, the King of glory, who cometh to judge the quick and the dead. Soon *“He that shall come will come, and will not tarry”* [Hebrews 10:37], the Judge of all. *“Behold, I come quickly; and My reward is with Me, to give every man according as his work shall be,”* saith the Lord [Revelation 22:12]. To Him be glory unto ages of ages. Amen.
